primary_comparator: Exact R WGCNA on the identical discovery event universe

claim_boundary.cohort_independence: Independent TCGA disease cohorts, not independent sequencing consortia or studies.
claim_boundary.confirmatory_rule: A strongest-program claim requires at least 70% paired best-Zsummary wins, a positive median best-Zsummary difference, and one-sided paired Wilcoxon P < 0.05. A complete-module-set claim additionally requires positive median-Zsummary and program-score preservation differences. No universal superiority claim is allowed unless locked metrics also favor CoSplice across at least three cross-study datasets.
claim_boundary.event_matching: Exact TCGA SpliceSeq event key only; no fuzzy coordinate matching.
claim_boundary.external_selection: External cohorts retain all eligible events; top-event selection is discovery-only.
